name: Retro Tower Defense
creator: Plaything Games
redeem: Launch Retro Tower Defense on Roblox and wait for the lobby to load.
Tap the Inventory button in the menu on the left side of the screen.
In the top-right corner of the inventory window, tap the gift box icon next to the Show All and X buttons.
Type or paste the code into the Enter Code Here box and press Redeem.
notes:
Retro Tower Defense is a Plaything Games strategy game built around old-school Roblox nostalgia. Waves of Noobs march along paths on maps modeled after classics like Crossroads and Doomspire, and you place towers based on iconic characters such as 1x1x1x1 and c00lkidd to stop them. You can play Casual, Normal, Hard or the infinite Endless mode alone or with friends, complete missions to unlock towers, and trade towers with other players.

Codes mostly give Tix, the currency you earn from winning rounds and spend on towers, and some add revives, skins, luck summons or trait rerolls. The developers usually drop codes alongside updates, events and holidays and announce them on their Discord.

faq.q: What is Tix used for in Retro Tower Defense?
faq.a: Tix is the game's main currency. You earn it by winning rounds and spend it on new towers. Most codes give Tix, and some older codes also gave a one-hour Tix boost that increases how much you earn.

faq.q: Where does Plaything Games post new Retro Tower Defense codes?
faq.a: The game's Roblox description lists current codes. Right now it names RETRO, FREETIX and NEW. New codes usually arrive with updates, events and holidays, and the developers announce them on their Discord.

faq.q: Can Retro Tower Defense codes give rewards other than Tix?
faq.a: Yes. Some past codes have been reported to give tower skins, revives, XP, 3x luck summons or trait rerolls. Reported skin codes include 1stBirthday for a Birthday 1x1x1x1 skin and MOSSY for a Mossy skin.

tips: Start on Casual to learn how the Noobs move on each map. Move up to Normal and Hard once your towers hold, and save Endless for testing a full lineup.
Missions are one of the main ways to unlock stronger towers. Check them before each match and pick modes that help you finish them, especially with friends.
Events bring their own currency for limited skins and towers. If you want those items, play during the event, because that currency only drops while it runs.
Look at the weekly challenge and the map mastery achievements too. They give you extra goals on maps like Crossroads and Doomspire that you already play.
useRewards: All three working codes give Tix, the same currency you earn by winning rounds. Redeem them before you shop and add them to your match earnings, since they can push you over the price of a tower you are close to buying. Older codes have handed out skins, revives and trait rerolls, so read each new code's reward and use rerolls only on towers you plan to keep.
